text.description_html:
Grandeur PSHSFR, San Francisco Solid Brass Push Plate

The San Francisco Solid Brass 3-1/16 x 18 Push Plate design is taken from the style of architecture made popular by Louis XVI c.1774-1792 which continued to remain popular for centuries by the european elite. This style still graces well-to-do establishments and grand homes, granting them a almost royal air. This gorgeous door push plate features patterned edges with incredible fine swirling detail on the top and bottom. Its long length makes it great for larger doors. The San Francisco Pushplate is cast in high quality brass and offered in your choice of 5 different luxurious finishes. It is packaged with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation.

Click here to see the entire Grandeur Nostalgic Warehouse Collection

Specifications of the Grandeur San Francisco Push Plate:

  • Width: 3-1/16"
  • Height: 18"
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Available Finishes: 5

No matter which finish you choose on the outside, it will still be brass material on the inside.
